summary_en: This study tests tarlatamab given with radiation therapy in people with tumors that express DLL3, including small cell lung cancer and several other cancer types. Tarlatamab is given by infusion, starting with a 1 mg step-up dose on Cycle 1 Day 1, then 10 mg on Cycle 1 Days 8 and 15 and every 2 weeks after that, until progression or up to 24 months. Radiation is given as standard of care, starting between Cycle 1 Day 16 and Cycle 2 Day 28. The main measure is safety, and a nested phase II part also measures objective response rate (ORR) in tumors that are not small cell lung cancer.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa tarlatamab administrado junto con radioterapia en personas con tumores que expresan DLL3, incluido el cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas y otros tipos de cáncer. Tarlatamab se administra por infusión, comenzando con una dosis inicial escalonada de 1 mg en el Ciclo 1 Día 1, luego 10 mg en el Ciclo 1 Días 8 y 15, y cada 2 semanas después, hasta la progresión o hasta 24 meses. La radioterapia se administra como tratamiento estándar, comenzando entre el Ciclo 1 Día 16 y el Ciclo 2 Día 28. La medida principal es la seguridad, y una parte de fase II anidada también mide la tasa de respuesta objetiva (ORR) en tumores que no son cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory small cell lung cancer or other tumors with small cell histology.
Certain high-grade neuroendocrine tumors with high DLL3 prevalence, or DLL3-positive tumors by IHC.
Progressed or recurred after at least one line of therapy.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Measurable lesion and eligible for external beam radiation to an unirradiated lesion.
not_for: Interstitial lung disease or active, non-infectious pneumonitis.
Recurrent grade 2 or higher pneumonitis, or severe immune-mediated reactions on immuno-oncology agents.
Planned re-irradiation of a previously irradiated site.
Myocardial infarction or symptomatic heart failure within 12 months of first dose.
